propositions: Advisory criteria lack a standing, sidecar-native effectiveness recorder that auto-includes new criteria at zero marginal LLM cost and emits detection/blocking-FP proxies without per-criterion wiring or outcome-corpus git-walks.

The recorder reads persisted REVIEW_RESULT sidecars and appends firing rows (ticket_id, review_ts_ns, round_uuid, criteria, norm_id, decision, severity, priority, drop_reason) to an append-only, prune-immune ledger criterion_firings.jsonl.

The --report mode computes per-criterion detection_proxy (fraction of blocking fix-units later remediated to PASS) and blocking_fp_proxy (fraction of blocking fix-units later de-escalated/dropped and never remediated to PASS) over a trailing window of reviewed tickets, auto-including every criterion id in the ledger.

The recorder is deterministic, idempotent (dedup key = ticket + review_ts + round_uuid + norm_id), and incremental (--record appends only reviews newer than the ledger's max recorded timestamp), making it suitable for standing periodic invocation.

The metrics artifact runs/criterion_effectiveness.json is computed over the existing sidecar corpus and proves the recorder works now with real values (17+ non-null detection_proxy, 12+ non-null blocking_fp_proxy across 40+ auto-included criteria).
